stances.reasoning: Co-authored a May 2026 op-ed advocating for publicly owned social housing and praised municipal housing vouchers. Her approach centers on public funding mechanisms and rent protections over market-rate supply expansion.

Wanted environmental amendments added to the upzoning reform before approval and advocates controlled growth with community benefit conditions. Her approach reflects allowing growth only where existing infrastructure supports it rather than streamlined permitting across the board.

Stated 'when I see veteran councillors walking back a legacy of standing up for human rights, that is chilling'; received Our Revolution endorsement. Her community organizing background and campaign platform center on strengthening civil rights enforcement and addressing systemic discrimination.
